events.title: DiffuSpace releases Clover-35B-A3B-Preview weights and code
events.title_zh: DiffuSpace 开放 Clover-35B-A3B-Preview 权重与代码
events.summary: DiffuSpace released ungated Apache-2.0 weights and code for Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, a 35B-total, 3B-active mixture-of-experts diffusion language model aimed at coding agents. The preview includes SGLang and llama.cpp paths. Its benchmark and throughput numbers are publisher-reported and have not been independently reproduced.
events.summary_en: DiffuSpace released ungated Apache-2.0 weights and code for Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, a 35B-total, 3B-active mixture-of-experts diffusion language model aimed at coding agents. The preview includes SGLang and llama.cpp paths. Its benchmark and throughput numbers are publisher-reported and have not been independently reproduced.
events.summary_zh: DiffuSpace 开放 Clover-35B-A3B-Preview 的权重与代码，采用 Apache-2.0 许可且无需申请。它是总参数 35B、每次激活约 3B 的 MoE 扩散语言模型，面向 coding agent，并提供 SGLang 与 llama.cpp 路径。benchmark 与吞吐数据均为发布方自测，尚未独立复现。
events.why_it_matters: For coding-agent teams, the public artifacts make the claimed quality/throughput trade-off testable. Preview status, uncommon diffusion decoding and unverified benchmark setup argue for a bounded trial rather than adoption.
events.why_it_matters_en: For coding-agent teams, the public artifacts make the claimed quality/throughput trade-off testable. Preview status, uncommon diffusion decoding and unverified benchmark setup argue for a bounded trial rather than adoption.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 coding agent 团队来说，公开产物让质量与吞吐的取舍可以实测。它仍是 Preview，扩散式解码也不同于常见自回归模型，且 benchmark 条件未独立核验，因此只适合有限试验。

technical_details.availability: Ungated weights, Apache-2.0 code, SGLang and llama.cpp paths
technical_details.vendor_benchmarks: SWE-bench Verified 73.6; Terminal-Bench 2.1 51.7; tau3 65.3; not independently reproduced
technical_details.vendor_throughput: 680 tokens/s on NVIDIA GB300 BF16 batch 1; publisher measurement

technical_details_zh.厂商吞吐: NVIDIA GB300、BF16、batch 1 下 680 token/s；为发布方测量

events.title: NVIDIA opens NemoClaw blueprints for controlled agent stacks
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 开放 NemoClaw 受控 agent 栈蓝图
events.summary: NVIDIA released MIT-licensed NemoClaw blueprints for assembling specialized agent stacks from existing harnesses, models, NeMo services and the OpenShell policy runtime. The initial integrations name OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and LangChain Deep Agents. It is a composable blueprint layer, not a replacement agent harness, and supports cloud, data-center, DGX Spark and RTX deployment paths.
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released MIT-licensed NemoClaw blueprints for assembling specialized agent stacks from existing harnesses, models, NeMo services and the OpenShell policy runtime. The initial integrations name OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and LangChain Deep Agents. It is a composable blueprint layer, not a replacement agent harness, and supports cloud, data-center, DGX Spark and RTX deployment paths.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 以 MIT 许可开放 NemoClaw 蓝图，用现有 agent harness、模型、NeMo 服务与 OpenShell 策略运行时组合专用 agent 栈。首批列出的集成包括 OpenClaw、Hermes Agent 与 LangChain Deep Agents。它是组合层，不是新的 agent harness；部署路径覆盖云、数据中心、DGX Spark 与 RTX。
events.why_it_matters: For teams that need owned execution and policy boundaries, NemoClaw provides a public integration path instead of a closed appliance. Its value still depends on reproducing policy isolation, telemetry and operating cost outside NVIDIA examples.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams that need owned execution and policy boundaries, NemoClaw provides a public integration path instead of a closed appliance. Its value still depends on reproducing policy isolation, telemetry and operating cost outside NVIDIA examples.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对需要自持执行面和策略边界的团队来说，NemoClaw 提供了公开组合路径，而不是封闭一体机。但它的价值仍取决于能否在 NVIDIA 示例之外复现策略隔离、可观测性与运维成本。

technical_details.integrations: OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and LangChain Deep Agents named at launch

events.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Rosalind Research under trusted access
events.title_zh: OpenAI 向受审研究机构开放 GPT-6 Rosalind
events.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Rosalind Research for approved organizations and authorized users in Work, Codex and the API. It is not available in Chat, and Enterprise deployments begin with a two-week Admin Preview. The model uses GPT-6 Astra weights without additional training or post-training.

It is not available in Chat, and Enterprise deployments begin with a two-week Admin Preview. The model uses GPT-6 Astra weights without additional training or post-training.

events.why_it_matters: For life-science teams, this makes a higher-capability biological reasoning configuration callable, but access review, governance and human oversight are part of the product boundary. Publisher safety evaluations do not establish independent research outcomes.

events.title: SenseNova opens a looped multimodal model for long-context agents
events.title_zh: SenseNova 开放长上下文循环多模态模型
events.summary: SenseNova released ungated Apache-2.0 weights and code for SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview, a text-and-image model for long-context and agentic workflows. It applies a 24-layer block twice, producing 56 layer executions from 32 distinct decoder layers, and was trained on sequences up to 256K tokens. Deployment currently relies on LightLLM main or an unmerged SGLang pull request.
events.summary_en: SenseNova released ungated Apache-2.0 weights and code for SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview, a text-and-image model for long-context and agentic workflows. It applies a 24-layer block twice, producing 56 layer executions from 32 distinct decoder layers, and was trained on sequences up to 256K tokens. Deployment currently relies on LightLLM main or an unmerged SGLang pull request.
events.summary_zh: SenseNova 开放 SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview 的权重与代码，无需申请并采用 Apache-2.0。它面向长上下文和 agent 工作流，可接收文本与图像；24 层模块重复执行两次，让 32 个独立 decoder 层完成 56 次计算，训练长度最高 256K。当前部署依赖 LightLLM main 或尚未合并的 SGLang PR。
events.why_it_matters: For local-agent teams, shared-weight looping offers a testable compute-versus-parameter trade-off without a larger stored checkpoint. Preview status, custom model code and immature serving support make a bounded trial appropriate.
events.why_it_matters_en: For local-agent teams, shared-weight looping offers a testable compute-versus-parameter trade-off without a larger stored checkpoint. Preview status, custom model code and immature serving support make a bounded trial appropriate.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对本地 agent 团队来说，共享权重循环提供了不扩大存储权重、却增加推理计算深度的可测取舍。Preview、custom code 与尚未成熟的 serving 支持决定它只适合有限试验。

technical_details.serving: LightLLM main; SGLang requires an unmerged pull request
technical_details.time_basis: Official announcement gives 2026-10-30 without an hour; repository artifacts were public before the overlap start, so this is a late discovery.

events.title: Google runs the first data-center TPU response in orbit
events.title_zh: Google 首次在轨运行数据中心级 TPU 推理
events.summary: Google's Project Suncatcher prototype returned the first AI response from a data-center-class TPU in orbit after running Gemma 4. The team had already powered the host and TPU trays and run early machine-learning tests. The next phase will test reliability under orbital thermal stress and radiation before a planned two-satellite experiment in 2027.
events.summary_en: Google's Project Suncatcher prototype returned the first AI response from a data-center-class TPU in orbit after running Gemma 4. The team had already powered the host and TPU trays and run early machine-learning tests. The next phase will test reliability under orbital thermal stress and radiation before a planned two-satellite experiment in 2027.
events.summary_zh: Google 的 Project Suncatcher 原型卫星运行 Gemma 4，返回首个由在轨数据中心级 TPU 生成的 AI 响应。团队此前已完成主机与 TPU 托盘上电和早期机器学习测试。下一阶段要验证热应力与辐射下的可靠性，并计划在 2027 年测试两颗互联卫星。
events.why_it_matters: For infrastructure planners, this proves only that inference can run in orbit, not that space compute is economical or reliable. Thermal, radiation, networking, launch and maintenance evidence still separates a moonshot from a deployable architecture.
events.why_it_matters_en: For infrastructure planners, this proves only that inference can run in orbit, not that space compute is economical or reliable. Thermal, radiation, networking, launch and maintenance evidence still separates a moonshot from a deployable architecture.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对基础设施决策者来说，这只证明推理能在轨运行，不证明太空算力具备经济性或可靠性。热环境、辐射、网络、发射与维护数据仍决定它是研究计划还是可部署架构。

technical_details.stage: Research prototype; thermal and radiation tests remain

technical_details_zh.下一里程碑: 计划 2027 年测试两颗互联卫星

events.title: OpenCode persists terminals and adds experimental agent artifacts
events.title_zh: OpenCode 持久化终端并加入实验性 agent 产物
events.summary: OpenCode 2.2.4 makes desktop terminals session-scoped, preserving names and scrollback across server restarts and synchronizing them across the TUI and windows. An opt-in provider API lets agents create, update and serve HTML or static artifacts, while schedules run under opencode serve with single-fire coordination. Version 2.2.5 adds percentage-based compaction buffers and repairs large MCP stdio messages, LiteLLM context errors and reasoning preservation across model switches and resume.
events.summary_en: OpenCode 2.2.4 makes desktop terminals session-scoped, preserving names and scrollback across server restarts and synchronizing them across the TUI and windows. An opt-in provider API lets agents create, update and serve HTML or static artifacts, while schedules run under opencode serve with single-fire coordination. Version 2.2.5 adds percentage-based compaction buffers and repairs large MCP stdio messages, LiteLLM context errors and reasoning preservation across model switches and resume.
events.summary_zh: OpenCode 2.2.4 把桌面终端改为 session 级，服务器重启后仍保留名称与 scrollback，并在 TUI 与窗口间同步。可选 provider API 允许 agent 创建、更新并托管 HTML 或静态产物；schedule 在 opencode serve 下运行并协调单次触发。2.2.5 又加入按比例设置的压缩缓冲，并修复大型 MCP stdio 消息、LiteLLM 上下文错误和切换模型或恢复后的 reasoning 保留。
events.why_it_matters: For coding-agent teams, persistent terminals and coordinated schedules reduce state loss in long tasks, while artifacts turn the agent into a lightweight preview surface. The artifact and schedule paths remain experimental and need restart and duplicate-fire tests before adoption.
events.why_it_matters_en: For coding-agent teams, persistent terminals and coordinated schedules reduce state loss in long tasks, while artifacts turn the agent into a lightweight preview surface. The artifact and schedule paths remain experimental and need restart and duplicate-fire tests before adoption.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 coding agent 团队来说，持久终端与协调 schedule 能减少长任务丢状态，artifact 则让 agent 直接生成预览面。但 artifact 与 schedule 仍是实验功能，采用前必须测试重启和重复触发。

technical_details.persistent_terminals: Session-scoped PTYs retain names and scrollback across server restarts and synchronize across clients
technical_details.experimental_artifacts: Opt-in CRUD and serving for HTML/static artifacts through a provider API
technical_details.schedules: Run under opencode serve with coordination intended to prevent duplicate firing
technical_details.reliability: Percentage compaction buffers; large MCP stdio, LiteLLM context and reasoning-resume fixes

technical_details_zh.持久终端: session 级 PTY 在服务器重启后保留名称与 scrollback，并跨客户端同步
technical_details_zh.实验性 artifact: 通过可选 provider API 对 HTML 与静态产物做 CRUD 和托管
technical_details_zh.schedule: 在 opencode serve 下运行，通过协调避免重复触发
technical_details_zh.可靠性: 按比例压缩缓冲；修复大型 MCP stdio、LiteLLM 上下文与 reasoning 恢复

events.next_action_zh: 一天内重启 serve 并并发运行两个 schedule，验证 PTY 恢复、单次触发、artifact 权限与 MCP 大消息。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, restart serve and run two schedules concurrently; verify PTY recovery, single firing, artifact permissions and large MCP messages.
